```{r}

# Load the dataset
data <- read.csv("/Users/varshap/Downloads/ST5188/Data/Final/TT Split/changi_train_wide.csv")

# Randomly select 1000 rows
set.seed(123)  # Ensures reproducibility
data <- data %>% sample_n(1000)

# Add small random noise to coordinates
set.seed(123)
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    x = x + runif(n(), -0.1, 0.1),  # Add noise to x
    y = y + runif(n(), -0.1, 0.1)   # Add noise to y
  )

#rescaling
# data <- data %>%
#   mutate(
#     x = (x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x)),
#     y = (y - min(y)) / (max(y) - min(y))
#   )

# Extract coordinates
coords <- as.matrix(data[, c("x", "y")])

# Define the formula for the first time point
formula <- `Mar.Apr.2000` ~ x + y

# Define priors
priors <- spTimer::spT.priors(
  model = "GP",
  inv.var.prior = spTimer::Gamm(2, 0.1),
  beta.prior = spTimer::Norm(0, 10^4)
)

priors <- spTimer::spT.priors(
  model = "GP",
  inv.var.prior = spTimer::Gamm(2, 0.1),  # Adjust the shape and scale
  beta.prior = spTimer::Norm(0, 10^4),     # Increase variance
  phi.prior = spTimer::Gam(2, 0.5)
)
# Define spatial decay prior using spT.decay
decay_prior <- spTimer::spT.decay(
  distribution = spTimer::Gamm(a = 2, b = 1),  # Gamma prior for phi
  tuning = 0.1,  # Tuning parameter 
  npoints = NULL,  # Number of points for discretization
  value = NULL     # Fixed value for phi 
)

# Fit the model
model <- spTimer::spT.Gibbs(
  formula = formula,
  data = data,
  coords = coords,
  model = "GP",
  priors = priors,
  nItr = 100,
  nBurn = 10,
  cov.fnc = "exponential",
  tol.dist = 1e-3
)

# Check model summary
summary(model)
```

```{r}
# Load the dataset
data <- read.csv("/Users/varshap/Downloads/ST5188/Data/Final/TT Split/changi_train_wide.csv")

# Randomly select 1000 rows
set.seed(123)  # Ensures reproducibility
data_sample <- data %>% sample_n(1000)

# Add small random noise to coordinates
data_sample <- data_sample %>%
  mutate(
    x = x + runif(n(), -0.1, 0.1),  # Add noise to x
    y = y + runif(n(), -0.1, 0.1)   # Add noise to y
  )

# Rescale coordinates
# data_sample <- data_sample %>%
#   mutate(
#     x = (x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x)),
#     y = (y - min(y)) / (max(y) - min(y))
#   )

# Extract the month columns 
month_cols <- names(data_sample)[grepl("\\d{4}", names(data_sample))]  # Select columns containing years

# Extract coordinates
coords <- as.matrix(data_sample[, c("x", "y")])

# Define priors
priors <- spTimer::spT.priors(
  model = "GP",
  inv.var.prior = spTimer::Gamm(2, 0.1),
  beta.prior = spTimer::Norm(0, 10^2)
)

priors <- spTimer::spT.priors(
  model = "GP",
  inv.var.prior = spTimer::Gamm(2, 0.1),  # Adjust the shape and scale
  beta.prior = spTimer::Norm(0, 10^2) #,     # Increase variance
  #phi.prior = spTimer::Gamm(2, 0.5)       # controls spatial decay--works in older version
)

# Define spatial decay prior using spT.decay
decay_prior <- spTimer::spT.decay(
  distribution = spTimer::Gamm(a = 2, b = 1),  # Gamma prior for phi
  tuning = 0.1,  # Tuning parameter 
  npoints = NULL,  # Number of points for discretization
  value = NULL     # Fixed value for phi 
)

# Loop over all months and fit the model
models <- list()
for (month in month_cols) {
  formula <- as.formula(paste0("`", month, "` ~ x + y"))  # Create formula dynamically
  
  # Fit the model
  model <- spTimer::spT.Gibbs(
    formula = formula,
    data = data_sample,
    coords = coords,
    model = "GP",
    priors = priors,
    #decay=decay_prior,  ##doesnt work
    nItr = 100,
    nBurn = 10,
    cov.fnc = "exponential",
    tol.dist = 1e-2
  )
  
  # Store model in the list
  models[[month]] <- model
  
  # Print progress
  cat("Finished model for:", month, "\n")
}

# Print summaries of all models
lapply(models, summary)

```
